### 2026-10-18 – I swear that when I started it I stared at the wall thinking this up for like more than 20 minutes, so I did this:

**5h**

I swear that when I started it I stared at the wall thinking this up for like more than 20 minutes, so I did this:
I made a case with a space as the bottom that can slide sideways, then added a hole for a kind of screw to act as the stop for the bottom part to not fall nor shake. Then added another piece that mounts on top of the bottom part as a separate compartiment to put other stuff.

And that's all I kinda messed up a little bit, as a bonus I added the screw holes for the Joystick in the top part and mounted everything together and looks great
